title: grip.verify Request/Response
description: Schemas for the grip.verify primitive — the three-tier deterministic verification gate.

VerifyRequest.description: Request to evaluate a hypothesis through the three-tier verification gate. Includes schema metadata for Tier 0 validation and rules for Tier 1 policy evaluation.

operation.description: The operation type. Affects which validation checks apply (e.g., read-only checks apply only to CREATE).

resourceId.description: The resource identifier. Required for DETECT/REMEDIATE, null for CREATE.

proposedProperties.description: Proposed resource properties for CREATE operations. Validated against the schema in Tier 0.

liveState.description: Current property values of the resource, fetched by grip.schema. Used for DETECT/REMEDIATE operations.

resourceSchema.description: The resource schema from grip.schema, containing property definitions and types.

requiredProperties.description: Property names required for creation, from grip.schema response.

readOnlyProperties.description: JSON pointer paths to read-only properties, from grip.schema response.

rules.description: Security rules to evaluate in Tier 1, loaded by grip.security. Format is provider-native.

VerifyResponse.description: Verification gate result containing the verdict, evidence chain, and per-tier violation counts.

verdict.description: VERIFIED: all rules across all tiers pass. VIOLATED: one or more rules failed. UNVERIFIED: no rules available for evaluation.

evidence.description: Evidence chain — one item per rule evaluated across all tiers.

rulesEvaluated.description: Total number of rules evaluated across all tiers.

violationsFound.description: Total number of rules that returned VIOLATED across all tiers.
